title: Auto-Suggest training sample
description: One training sample for the Auto-Suggest model (zetta#554, FEAT-11): given a customer's CURRENT DATA STATE, suggest ZERO-to-many use cases as prompts that feed the pipeline-building agent (#555). Grown by gen_autosuggest_corpus.py from the solutions catalog; verifiable because the data state is constructed to support a known set of use cases, and distractors (data absent) must NOT be suggested.

data_state.description: The customer's current data — the model's input.

profile.description: row counts / null rates / freshness, prose

suggestions.description: Zero-to-many use cases the data SUPPORTS — each a prompt to feed the agent.

prompt.description: the intent handed to the agent model

rationale.description: which data in the state supports it

distractors.description: Use cases the data does NOT support — must NOT be suggested (the discrimination signal).
